Hello Helium D.,

I’m following up again regarding my MiniNerd replacement RMA for the defective power supply.

FedEx tracking ···· confirms the returned unit was delivered to you on September 11, 2026.

It’s now been over six weeks, and I still haven’t received an update on my replacement.

Could you please provide the current status and an estimated shipping date for the replacement unit?

If the newer ventilated/fan-cooled MiniNerd replacement is not available, I would be happy to proceed with the Magic M. 40T instead.

Thank you,

Scott H.

(email hidden)

(phone hidden)
Passed the chat to support · Scott H. wants replacement RMA status and a ship date (returned unit deliver
Note to the team: Handed to support.

Thank you for the update. I appreciate you passing this along to the team. I will wait for them to follow up with the details directly. Please let me know if you need anything else from my end in the meantime.

Thank you
Scott H.

Hi Scott,

Nothing further is needed from you right now. Just keep the Thor P2 in its original packaging and unopened, which is exactly what you have already done, and that keeps the upgrade option clean.

The open points are the value credited for the Thor P2 return, your $110.28 store credit, the balance owed on the Magic M. 40T and the shipping estimate for it. Those are all pricing and order decisions, so a colleague picks this up when the team is back tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you in this same email thread.

If anything technical comes up in the meantime, setup, pool configuration, hashrate or power on either unit, reply here and I will take care of it.

Thanks for your patience, Scott.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
